title: Spaghetti with Pickle Slaw
description: A twist on traditional pasta salads, this recipe combines spaghetti, a tangy pickle slaw, and a hint of Italian flair.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a medium bowl, combine diced nectarine and pickle.
Season with Italian seasoning and toss to coat.
Once spaghetti is cooked, drain and rinse with cold water.
Combine cooked spaghetti and pickle-nectarine mixture.
Toss to coat and serve immediately.
